data.camera: 充满亲和力与包容感的中景正面像，完美展现B班领袖如春风拂面般温暖人心的圣母神采

data.description: 高度育成高中宿舍熄灯前的温存。B班的领袖一之濑帆波刚刚结束了帮班级同学辅导功课的忙碌时光，换上一套香槟淡粉色的罗纹莫代尔柔软分体睡衣。她将双腿抱在单人布艺沙发的扶手前，粉金色的发丝随性垂在胸口。看着心事重重的绫小路（或你），她温柔地递上一杯刚泡好的花草茶，蓝粉色的双眸盛满了全然的接纳与包容——「绫小路君……不管遇到了什么困难，都不用一个人默默承受哦。帆波会一直在这里听你倾诉……只要能让你稍微轻松一点，我随时都在。」
promptTokens: dusty rose pink ribbed modal camisole
curling legs gently onto cushioned single armchair
holding warm porcelain mug of herbal tea
strawberry blonde hair falling softly around lovely face
warm loving sapphire-blue eyes gazing with boundless empathy
scented candle flickers gently on table
data.promptProse: Honami Ichinose providing an oasis of unconditional warmth in her high-school dorm room late in the evening. She wears an ultra-soft dusty-rose ribbed modal camisole and matching sleep shorts. Tucking her legs comfortably into an armchair while cradling a steaming mug of tea, her luminous sapphire eyes gaze with boundless, gentle empathy that melts all anxiety away.
